summary: The HSPnetPager is a custom web control used in ASP.NET applications for paging functionality, providing navigation through a set of paginated data.
purpose: To provide a user interface for navigating pages of data in a web application by utilizing a set of controls and state management.

fields.name: ItemCount
fields.description: Gets or sets total number of rows.

fields.name: CurrentIndex
fields.description: Gets or sets current page index.

fields.name: PageSize
fields.description: Gets or sets page size (results per page).

fields.name: PageCount
fields.description: Gets or sets the total number of pages.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.description: Calculates the starting row based on the current index and page size.

workflows.name: Render Pager
steps: Verify page rendering in server form.

workflows.name: State Management
steps: OnInit: Register control for state management.
SaveControlState: Save current state for index, size, and count.
LoadControlState: Retrieve and set state from saved status.

calculations.name: PageCount Calculation
calculations.description: Calculate number of pages based on item count and page size using ceiling.

system_behavior.description: Toggle between paged and show all mode by altering page size.
Update pagination controls dynamically based on current index and page count.

dependencies.name: Resources
dependencies.description: Used for retrieving localized strings like 'Previous' and 'Next'.
